subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should Telegram forum deletion be supported, and if so what permanent action name, default-off configuration gate, and approval or authorization boundary must protect deletion of a topic and all messages?
rationale: Close and reopen are reversible can_manage_topics operations, while deleteForumTopic is permanent and requires can_delete_messages; repository behavior cannot safely choose that destructive policy automatically.

options.title: Split reversible and destructive actions
options.body: Add topic-close and topic-reopen normally, while adding topic-delete behind a dedicated default-off gate and explicit destructive-action authorization contract.

options.title: Ship reversible lifecycle only
options.body: Add close and reopen now but leave permanent deletion unsupported until a broader destructive-action policy exists.

options.title: Keep create and edit only
options.body: Retain the current surface and decline agent-controlled topic archival or deletion.

recommendation.title: Split reversible and destructive actions
recommendation.body: Add topic-close and topic-reopen normally, while adding topic-delete behind a dedicated default-off gate and explicit destructive-action authorization contract.
